Kerusso vs Elevated Faith | Which Christian Clothing Brand Wins? - All Christian Blog

Christian apparel has moved beyond simple church T-shirts. Today, it is a global movement where believers proudly wear their faith on their sleeves—literally. Two names dominate the conversation in 2025: Kerusso and Elevated Faith.

Both brands have loyal followers, massive reach, and very different approaches to spreading the Gospel through clothing. But which one truly stands out? In this detailed review and comparison, we’ll look at their history, products, style, pricing, reputation, and influence—so you can decide which brand fits your faith and lifestyle best.

## Kerusso Review: Is It Worth Buying in 2025?

### Q: What is Kerusso known for?

Kerusso, founded in 1987, is one of the oldest and largest Christian clothing brands in the world. It is known for bold, evangelistic T-shirts that carry strong Biblical messages. With over 100 million products sold, Kerusso has become almost synonymous with Christian apparel.

### Quick Facts about Kerusso

- Founded: 1987
- Founder: Vic Kennett
- Headquarters: Berryville, Arkansas, USA
- Reach: Global (sold in 100+ countries)
- Main Products: T-shirts, jewelry, gifts, drinkware, accessories
- Audience: Broad—families, churches, ministries, mission groups

### Strengths of Kerusso

1. Heritage & Trust – With nearly four decades in business, Kerusso is considered the pioneer of Christian fashion.

2. Affordability – Most T-shirts range between $15–$30, making them accessible to families and bulk orders for ministries.

3. Wide Distribution – Available in Christian bookstores, church conferences, and global markets—not just online.

4. Evangelistic Design – Their slogans and designs are often conversation starters for sharing the Gospel.

### Weaknesses of Kerusso

1. Conservative Style – While bold, their designs often feel traditional, which may not attract Gen Z or fashion-forward believers.

2. Limited Trend Appeal – Compared to modern streetwear-inspired brands, Kerusso sometimes lacks the “cool factor.”

3. Heavy Competition – With new faith-based brands emerging, Kerusso’s traditional approach risks being overshadowed.

### Verdict on Kerusso:

Kerusso is perfect if you want affordable, traditional Christian apparel with a strong evangelistic edge. It appeals most to families, churches, and believers who prioritize message over fashion trends.

---

## Elevated Faith Review: Is It Worth Buying in 2025?

### Q: Why is Elevated Faith so popular?

Elevated Faith, launched in 2015, is the modern face of Christian fashion. Known for its minimalist designs, jewelry, and trendy clothing, it resonates deeply with Millennials and Gen Z.

### Quick Facts about Elevated Faith

- Founded: 2015
- Founder: Josh Gander
- Headquarters: Scottsdale, Arizona, USA
- Reach: 100+ countries (strong online presence)
- Main Products: T-shirts, hoodies, rings, bracelets, stickers, accessories

One of my favorite Christian companies is Elevated Faith. I absolutely love their products! They offer a variety of different styles of products, and they have both men’s and women’s sizing in most items. They offer everything from jewelry to apparel to stickers, and in my experience, the quality has been fantastic. Additionally, their apparel is made in the USA, a bonus that I happen to love!

I love that, as you can find on their website, the founder Josh Gander said he wanted none of the glory, but that all would go to God. Below is their purpose that I found on their website.

Elevated Faith creates conversation starters: jewelry and apparel that open doors for wearers to tell friends and strangers about their faith.

In my first order, I purchased stickers and three rings. (I posted pictures at the bottom of this page!) I have now had the rings for over 6 months, and the quality has stayed impressive. I have also purchased their Highs and Lows Hoodie, which I wear almost every day. The comfort of this sweatshirt led me to also buy their Made in the Image of God Hoodie(I also wear this all the time)!

I have found that wearing these products is such a great way to share my faith. Many Elevated Faith items offer a simple message, and I believe because of this they are great conversation starters. I also have a bracelet from Elevated Faith that I receive endless compliments on, which has a small golden bar that reads Jesus is King, a simple yet powerful statement!

In addition to being a great way to share my faith, I have noticed that the pieces I own have become great daily reminders to live and love as Jesus did. I wear one ring that has on it the believed coordinates of the birthplace of Jesus. It is such a great reminder whenever I look at it, to live how Jesus did.

Also, I have added a handful of their stickers to my laptop. One of my favorites says, “be the reason someone believes that God is good.” I put it on the base of my keyboard – right next to the trackpad so I see it every time I use my laptop. It is such a simple, beautiful, and powerful reminder that I am always representing not only myself, but also God and His love.

If you have been looking for an easy and stylish way to share your faith, I would definitely recommend checking out their website. They offer a huge variety and it is all so comfortable and cute! # Elevated Faith Review: Faith-Inspired Jewelry and Apparel with Meaning

In a world where fashion often focuses only on trends, Elevated Faith offers something different — products designed to inspire faith, encourage positivity, and support meaningful causes. The brand has gained significant popularity among Christian communities, especially young people looking for ways to express their beliefs through everyday style.

You can explore their full collection directly on their official website: https://elevatedfaith.com/

---

## Brand Overview

Elevated Faith is a faith-based lifestyle brand that creates Christian jewelry, apparel, accessories, and devotionals. The company’s mission goes beyond fashion; it aims to help people wear their faith boldly and spark conversations about God.

One of the most distinctive aspects of the brand is its commitment to giving back. A portion of every purchase supports charitable organizations around the world, helping provide resources such as food, clean water, and education to those in need.

---

## Product Quality and Design

### Jewelry

Elevated Faith is widely known for its faith-inspired jewelry, including:

Cross necklaces

Scripture bracelets

Faith rings

Minimalist Christian symbols

The designs are typically simple, modern, and meaningful, making them suitable for daily wear. Most pieces are crafted from stainless steel, gold plating, or sterling silver, which helps ensure durability while maintaining a clean aesthetic.

Customers often appreciate the subtlety of the designs — they express faith without being overly flashy.

---

### Apparel

Elevated Faith also offers a wide range of Christian clothing, such as:

T-shirts

Hoodies

Sweatshirts

Hats

These items often feature Bible verses, uplifting messages, or creative faith-based graphics. The clothing is designed with comfort and modern streetwear trends in mind, appealing especially to younger audiences.

The fabrics are generally soft and comfortable, making them ideal for casual wear while still conveying a deeper message.

---

## Mission and Social Impact

One of the strongest aspects of Elevated Faith is its mission-driven business model.

The company regularly partners with charitable organizations and commits to donating a portion of its profits to meaningful causes. These initiatives have supported projects such as:

Providing clean drinking water

Supporting orphanages

Disaster relief

Feeding communities in need

For many customers, this charitable element adds extra value to every purchase, knowing their money contributes to positive change.

---

## Customer Experience

Elevated Faith has built a strong online community through its website and social media platforms.

Key strengths include:

A visually appealing and easy-to-navigate website

Regular product launches and limited collections

Engaging faith-based content on social media
